hook_line: JAILER 2 HINDI EARNS RS 43.8 CRORE IN 15 DAYS, BOOKS 68% PROFIT OVER BREAKEVEN

hook_stat.sub: Profit over the Rs 26 crore breakeven for Jailer 2 Hindi

stats.label: Hindi net collection in India in 15 days
Worldwide gross after 15 days across all languages
Hindi net needed for a hit verdict on Koimoi's parameters

diaspora_bullets: The run is playing in North American and Gulf theatres
Overseas gross reached Rs 264 crore after 15 days
news_summary: The Hindi dubbed version of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has earned Rs 43.8 crore net in India in 15 days, booking a profit of Rs 17.8 crore, or 68.46 percent, over its Rs 26 crore breakeven, according to Koimoi.
payoff: The Hindi version needs Rs 52 crore net for a hit verdict, with about six days of open run before Ramayana Part One releases.
